prompt:
Create a coordinated, implementation-ready mockup of TripLOG’s “여행 개요” and “일정 계획” as two side-by-side mobile app screens. Preserve the existing TripLOG design: white background, black TRIPLOG wordmark with LOG inside a pink outlined box, lemon yellow #fff05a, sky blue #bce6fb, pale pink #f7afc7, dark ink #0b1020, thin dark borders, small hard offset shadows, and simple outline icons. Make both screens compact and highly readable, with 24px page titles, 18px trip titles, 15–16px primary content, 12–13px secondary text, restrained bold type, and comfortable touch targets. Use consistent spacing and the same bottom navigation: “개요”, “일정”, “지출”, “리포트”, “더보기”.

Overview: compact header with logo, “동기화”, and menu; title “여행 개요” with a small yellow “+ 새 여행” button. A compact trip summary shows “D-10”, “오사카·교토 가족여행”, “9.25 금 – 9.28 월 · 3박 4일”, and “2명”. Two equal-width reservation shortcuts show “교통 예약”, “3건”, “제주항공 · 서울 → 오사카” and “숙소 예약”, “2건”, “난바 · 교토”; counts remain visible. A budget section shows “여행 예산”, “2,354,695원”, “예산 3,500,000원”, a slim yellow 67% progress bar, and “남은 예산 1,145,305원”. A first-day schedule section shows “첫날 일정”, “9.25 금”, “전체 보기”, and three clearly aligned time/place rows: “11:00 간사이공항”, “12:30 난바에서 점심”, “14:00 오사카성”. Include a compact “준비물” row with “1 / 3개 완료” and a yellow “일정 보러 가기” action.

Itinerary: same header; title “일정 계획”, a small “전체 일정” control, and “오사카·교토 가족여행” subtitle. A single horizontally scrolling row of compact day buttons from “Day 1 · 9.25 금” to “Day 4 · 9.28 월”, with Day 1 selected in yellow. Show “9월 25일 (금)”, “일정 4개 · 이동 45분”, and a small blue “지도 보기” button. Use a compact vertical timeline: left aligned times, slim connecting line, small markers, and readable bordered place rows with visible edit icons. Entries: “11:00 간사이공항” with “이동” and “난카이 공항선 이용”; “12:30 난바에서 점심” with “맛집”; “14:00 오사카성” with “명소” and “조이패스 사용”; “16:30 우메다 공중정원” with “명소” and “17시 전 입장”. Between entries show subtle expandable travel rows, including “기차 30분” and “도보 15분”. Place a compact yellow “+ 일정 추가” action above the shared bottom navigation. Keep all content in Korean, visually aligned, and ready to reproduce as a responsive working interface.
